name: naver-ads
description: 네이버 검색광고 API — 키워드 검색량(PC/모바일)·클릭수·CPC·경쟁도·연관검색어와 입찰가별 예상성과, 업종·시즌 키워드 발굴, 내 광고 성과·잔액·캠페인 관리.

autoCacheWhole.keyword-tool: Pass this key as keywordsCacheKey to naver-ads estimate or managed-keywords to reuse the analyzed keywords without retyping them, or as a row source when building a sheet.

actions.name: 키워드 분석 (검색량·클릭수·경쟁도·연관검색어 + CPC)
actions.description: The keyword research entry point. Returns monthly search counts (PC and mobile), average click counts and CTR, competition index and average ad depth, plus related keywords

actions.name: 입찰가·성과 추정 (CPC 계산)
actions.description: Where CPC comes from

actions.name: 키워드 제한 상태 (저검색량·성인·노출제한·판매금지·시즌)
actions.description: Why a keyword has no numbers

actions.name: 업종 코드 목록 (biztpId)
actions.description: The industry tree behind keyword-tool's biztpId

actions.name: 시즌 이벤트 코드 목록 (event)
actions.description: The seasonal theme codes behind keyword-tool's event parameter

actions.name: 내 광고 성과 통계
actions.description: Performance of MY running ads by campaign / adgroup / keyword / ad id

actions.name: 비즈머니 잔액·충전·소진 내역
actions.description: Ad account balance and its charge / exhaust / daily histories.

actions.name: 캠페인 목록
actions.description: Lists campaigns in the ad account.

actions.name: 캠페인 단건
actions.description: One campaign by id.

actions.name: 광고그룹 목록
actions.description: Lists adgroups, optionally within one campaign.

actions.name: 광고그룹 단건
actions.description: One adgroup by id.

actions.name: 등록 키워드 목록
actions.description: Keywords registered in MY account, with their bids and quality index. Not a research tool — use keyword-tool for that.

actions.name: 등록 키워드 단건
actions.description: One registered keyword by id.

actions.name: 소재 목록
actions.description: Ad creatives in an adgroup.

actions.name: 소재 단건
actions.description: One ad creative by id.

actions.name: 비즈채널 목록
actions.description: Business channels. The SITE-type channel id is what keyword-tool's siteId takes.

actions.name: 확장소재 목록
actions.description: Ad extensions belonging to a campaign or adgroup.

actions.name: 즐겨찾기 목록
actions.description: Labels registered in the account.

actions.name: 공유예산 목록
actions.description: Shared budgets in the account.

actions.name: API 직접 호출
actions.description: Escape hatch for endpoints this module does not wrap. Signs and sends the request as given.

keywords.description: [keyword-tool/estimate/managed-keywords] Keywords. Plain strings, or rows carrying a `keyword` field (which is what keywordsCacheKey expands into). Chunked automatically past the per-call vendor caps: 5 hints for keyword-tool, 200 keys for estimate.

showDetail.description: [keyword-tool] Include per-month search history for each keyword

siteId.description: [keyword-tool] Business channel id, SITE type only (nccBusinessChannelId). An entry point on its own — see list-channels

biztpId.description: [keyword-tool] Industry id. An entry point on its own: with no keywords, returns that industry's keyword universe. Get ids from the biz-categories action

event.description: [keyword-tool] Seasonal theme id (e.g. 84 = 캠핑, 42 = 크리스마스). An entry point on its own. Get ids from the seasonal-events action

limit.description: [keyword-tool] How many related keywords to include. The vendor can return up to 1000; anything dropped is reported in the note

withBid.description: [keyword-tool] Attach estimated CPC per keyword: minBidPc/minBidMobile (minimum bid that still gets shown) and medianBidPc/medianBidMobile. Costs extra calls, chunked in 200s

withFlags.description: [keyword-tool] Attach isLowSearchVolume / isRestricted / isAdult / isSellProhibit / isSeason, which explain why a keyword has no numbers

bidPeriod.description: [keyword-tool withBid] Statistics window for the bid estimate: DAY = yesterday, MONTH = last 28 days

bidDevice.description: [keyword-tool withBid] Only price this device. Omit to get both PC and mobile columns

query.description: [seasonal-events/biz-categories] Filter the code table by name

refresh.description: [biz-categories] Rebuild the industry table from Naver instead of using the on-disk copy

jobId.description: [biz-categories] Resume polling a master report job id returned by an earlier call

id.description: [stats/get-*] Single entity id (campaign / adgroup / keyword / ad)

fields.description: [stats] Metrics. impCnt=impressions, clkCnt=clicks, salesAmt=cost, ctr=click rate, cpc=cost per click, avgRnk=average rank, ccnt=conversions

datePreset.description: [stats] Preset range, used instead of timeRange

breakdown.description: [stats] Split by pcMblTp=PC/mobile or dayw=day of week

estimateType.description: [estimate] exposure-minimum-bid=lowest bid that still gets shown, median-bid=middle of current bids, average-position-bid=bid for a target rank, performance=one keyword across many bids, performance-bulk=many keyword+bid pairs

keyType.description: [estimate] Whether the entries in `keywords` are keyword strings or registered keyword ids

key.description: [estimate] A single keyword or id. Shorthand for a one-entry `keywords` list

bids.description: [estimate:performance] Bid amounts in KRW to simulate. The response is one impression/click/cost row per bid

bid.description: [estimate:performance] A single bid. Shorthand for a one-entry `bids` list

position.description: [estimate:average-position-bid] Target ad rank: 1-10 on PC, 1-5 on MOBILE

device.description: [estimate] Device. BOTH is accepted by performance only

period.description: [estimate] Statistics window: DAY = yesterday, MONTH = last 28 days. This is an enum, not a number of days

items.description: [estimate:performance-bulk] Keyword and bid pairs, chunked in 200s

keywords.description: [keyword-tool] Rows for the hint keywords themselves

output.description: Shape differs per action. keyword-tool={keywords,relatedKeywords} where each row carries monthlyPcQcCnt/monthlyMobileQcCnt (null when the vendor masked a count under 10), monthlyAve*ClkCnt, monthlyAve*Ctr, plAvgDepth, compIdx, and with withBid/withFlags also minBid*/medianBid* and the restriction flags. estimate={estimate:[...]}, managed-keywords/biz-categories/seasonal-events={rows:[...]}, stats/bizmoney=vendor response.
